regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a narrowing eligible set (44% of themes eligible) with Oil & Gas Producers as the dominant leader (rank 1, durability 0.74, crowded) and Gold Miners as a distant challenger (durability 0.42). The backtest verdict confirms the only validated edge is absolute-trend-gate drawdown control, with momentum rank as focus-only and rotation timing display-only; my own track record shows decent hit rate (0.598) but weak direction accuracy (0.316), so conviction should be capped low-to-medium.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners as a possible challenger to Oil & Gas: the rotation margin is 0.542 and Gold is rank 2 but with thin breadth and modest durability. The condition that would retire this watch is Gold Miners' breadth rising above 0.3 AND durability_bar climbing above 0.6, which would confirm a broadening leadership base; if instead Oil & Gas' durability stays above 0.7 while Gold's breadth stays under 0.1, the handoff hypothesis fades.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the rank-1 theme, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with a high durability bar (0.74) and full breadth (1.0). The trend-gate leg (the one validated edge) keeps it in the allocation universe; the crowding flag (z 1.26) is a sizing caution, not a fade. This is a trend-continuation lean conditional on the gate staying green.
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and hurst_tag is 'mixed', meaning the trend is not cleanly persistent; the momentum rank itself has no forward alpha, so leadership could stall without warning.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls below its absolute-trend gate and drops out of the eligible set before the 21-day check-by

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is rank 2 and still eligible, offering non-Energy exposure. Durability is modest (0.42) and breadth is very thin (0.067), suggesting leadership is narrow and may not be well-absorbed across the theme. The lean is weak and conditional on the trend-gate remaining green and leadership not rolling over.
theses.dissent: Breadth near zero implies the theme's strength rests on very few names; the thin base makes it fragile and prone to sharp reversals if the leadership name stalls.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses eligibility via the absolute-trend gate before the 21-day check-by

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is rank 4, eligible, with a solid durability bar (0.65), 'trend' hurst tag, and breadth over 0.5. It is not crowded. This is a defensive, trend-gate-passing theme with steadier character than the crowded Energy leader, but no momentum edge to assert.
theses.dissent: Financials can be rate-sensitive and the macro backdrop is AI/geopolitics-driven with high unscheduled-surprise share; a rate surprise could destabilize bank leadership quickly.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO falls below its absolute-trend gate and drops out of the eligible set before the 21-day check-by

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
